status: 三个独立候选均待用户选择，未替换现行分镜
purpose: 校正椅面高度、人物尺度和落座支撑；同一原场景下三种轻微取景方案。

entries.name: A-原机位统一坐高
entries.prompt:
Create ONE independent landscape16:9 ensemble seated council image, high-end feature-film CGI. Image1 EMPTY ROOM is authoritative untouched furniture architecture table dimensions and FIVE chair shapes. Image2 ONLY provides six character identities outfits and order, its OVERSIZED king and dog and mismatched chair/figure heights are WRONG and must be rebuilt. Image3 authoritative exact dark dragon king face wide brocade costume flat black bead crown and gold antlers. Image4 exact elegant genuine multieye spider noblewoman plum gold webgown pearl bun mandibles diamondring. Image5 exact crowned silvergray wolf blackgold coat burgundy waistcoat.
CRITICAL solve UNIFIED WORLD SCALE and SEAT HEIGHTS from scratch. All five adults fit one standard adult-size chair set: seat cushion about45cm from floor, table about75cm, natural cushion-to-table difference30cm. Every pelvis actually rests at cushion height, thighs horizontal below tabletop, knees90degrees, feet flat floor, no hovering or tiny chairs under giant people. Chair backs rise around shoulder level below head. Perspective explains chair apparent sizes, same real chair scale. Body proportions long natural torsos modest heads. Five comparable adult seated heights, king only slightly tall regal, NOT giant relative to others, NO elevated throne platform. King far center must look perspective-SMALLER than foreground figures, shoulder width roughly comparable to far elephant/crocodile rather than entire far end width. Spider left-near and wolf right-near have comparable seated head/shoulder levels and body scale, spider not miniature. Elephant left-far naturally sturdy but head not huge; crocodile right-far comparable adult stature. Establish coherent approximately common eye-height horizon for seated participants, crown/bun/antlers protrude above that, not huge arbitrary gaps. Foreground pair slightly larger than far pair naturally. Fit figures to existing seats not vice versa.
Preserve source rectangular table absolutely: ONE straight continuous slab, unchanged symmetric longedges frontedge original floral corners orbital gold flat inlay jade pedestal, no notch wing bending or reshaping. All heads crown ears and feet fully in shot with margin.
Seat order from entrance: dark dragon king far centered head chair; slateblue suited gray elephant goldround glasses brass valvewheel brooch LEFT FAR; spider noblewoman LEFT NEAR, TWO hands plus EIGHT back spider appendages lower pair may hide; olivegray longsnout crocodile roundglasses brown coat paired brass starwheel clasps RIGHT FAR; silverwolf RIGHT NEAR. Both side pairs face inward along table LONGSIDES, knees under tabletop not forward toward camera. Two distinct black trouser legs and two naturally grounded wolf dress shoes no extra feet. Both right characters' forearms reach inward onto blackstone tabletop and connected wrists/hands supported there. Crocodile open ledger redpen and wolf closed ledger entirely ON tabletop inside gold rim never on laps.
ONE black THREEheaded FOURfooted dog six ears amber eyes leather brass stud collar square star pendant at FLOOR beside king viewer-left, near far-left table corner. Dog head/chest proportionate to big real dog, not another elephant or fourth seated adult, no chair no paws on table. All mouths closed silently listening.
Room blue coastal dusk left windows right dark cabinet bays narrow jade panels jade round constellation wall black dragon flags open ringchandelier. Refined physically based crisp natural scales fur pearl jade leather weighted cloth raised goldthread, soft warm key coolblue fill restrained highlights, no plastic goldglow smear text watermark collage.
VARIANT: Camera exactly source1 frontal centered wide establishing viewpoint. Strictly match source1 furniture scale. Put natural pelvis/cushion contact and grounded feet first. Reduce king upperbody from image2 by about20%, dog by15%, bring spider upright to peer-height with wolf.
